description: This file contains utility functions for E2SM KPM labels and scope conversions, ASN.1 label to enum mapping, and comparison operators for UE ID structures within the ocudu namespace.

methods.name: ocudu::e2sm_kpm_label_2_str
methods.description: Converts e2sm_kpm_label_enum to its string representation.

methods.name: ocudu::e2sm_kpm_scope_2_str
methods.description: Converts e2sm_kpm_metric_level_enum to its string representation.

methods.name: ocudu::asn1_label_2_enum
methods.description: Maps ASN.1 measurement label structure to corresponding label enum.

methods.name: operator== (const asn1::e2sm::ue_id_c&)
methods.description: Checks equality of two ue_id_c objects.

methods.name: operator!= (const asn1::e2sm::ue_id_c&)
methods.description: Checks inequality of two ue_id_c objects.

methods.name: operator< (const asn1::e2sm::ue_id_c&)
methods.description: Defines less-than comparison for ue_id_c objects.

methods.name: operator== (const asn1::e2sm::ue_id_gnb_du_s&)
methods.description: Checks equality of two ue_id_gnb_du_s objects.

methods.name: operator< (const asn1::e2sm::ue_id_gnb_du_s&)
methods.description: Defines less-than comparison for ue_id_gnb_du_s objects.
